findings.title: Hard-coded AWS access key committed to the repository
findings.evidence: A new module-level constant stores an AWS access key directly in code, making the credential available to anyone with repository access and likely to logs, artifacts, and downstream copies.
findings.recommendation: Remove the embedded credential from source immediately, rotate the exposed key, and load AWS credentials from the standard boto3 credential chain or a secure secret manager/environment variable instead of hard-coding them.
